mapper.select: select count(*) from user where create_time like concat(#{today}, '%')
select count(*) from blog where status = #{status}
select count(*) from report where status = 'PENDING'
select c.name as name, count(b.id) as value from category c left join blog b on b.category_id = c.id and b.status = 'PUBLISHED' and b.visibility = 'PUBLIC' group by c.id, c.name order by value desc
select date as name, count(*) as value from blog where status = 'PUBLISHED' and date >= #{startDate} group by date
select date(create_time) as name, count(*) as value from user where create_time is not null and create_time >= #{startDate} group by date(create_time)
select title as name, read_count as value from blog where status = 'PUBLISHED' and visibility = 'PUBLIC' order by read_count desc limit 10
select b.id, b.title, u.name as userName, b.date from blog b left join user u on b.user_id = u.id where b.status = 'PENDING' order by b.id desc limit 5
